note: Written by Claude for Moon Tree Farm. One item per week, oldest first. Photos are filenames in the moontreefarm.com media library.

facebook.text:
Every bar starts the same way: somebody gets up, milks the goats, and carries the bucket back to the kitchen.

That is the whole difference between our soap and the bar at the store. Goat milk from animals we know by name, poured, cut by hand, cured for weeks before it ever gets a label.

Wildflower Whisper, Petals at Dusk, Clementine Skies — all on the shelf right now.

moontreefarm.com/market
facebook.why: October is when people start buying soap as gifts. Lead with how it is made, not with a discount.

tiktok.hook: Hold up a bar and say nothing for three seconds. Then: "This started as a bucket of milk this morning."
tiktok.shots: Milking, close and honest. The bucket coming inside. Pouring into the mold. Cutting the loaf into bars. End on the finished bar in a hand.
tiktok.caption: Bucket to bar. No shortcuts, no filler. #goatmilksoap #handmadesoap #floridafarm
tiktok.sound: Keep the real sound - the milk, the knife through the loaf. That is the whole video.

tiktok.hook: "Name a soap ingredient you can pronounce." Then start naming ours.
tiktok.shots: One ingredient at a time on the counter, hands placing each one. Finish with the bar.
tiktok.caption: Five things. That is the list. #ingredients #handmadesoap
tiktok.sound: Something calm and current, low under the voice.

tiktok.hook: The cut. Just the cut, slowed down.
tiktok.shots: One long shot of the loaf being cut into bars, slowed to half speed. Nothing else.
tiktok.caption: Sound on for this one. #soapcutting #oddlysatisfying

facebook.text:
Florida finally remembered it has a second season.

This is the month to come out to the farm. The goats are in a good mood, the pavilion is comfortable again, and you can stand in a pasture at four in the afternoon without regretting it.

Farm stays, classes and half-day experiences are open for booking. Bring the kids. Bring somebody who has never met a goat.

moontreefarm.com
facebook.why: October is the best visiting month in North Florida and the one people forget to book.

tiktok.hook: "Things to do in Florida in October that are not a theme park."
tiktok.shots: Goats on the tires. The pavilion. Somebody feeding a bottle. The pasture wide, late afternoon light.
tiktok.caption: Forty minutes from Gainesville. No lines. #keystoneheights #floridathingstodo #farmvisit
tiktok.sound: Something warm and upbeat that is trending this week.

tiktok.hook: Goats jumping on tires, no words, first frame.
tiktok.shots: Thirty seconds of goats being goats. Cut on the jumps.
tiktok.caption: They do this all day. #goatsoftiktok #farmlife
tiktok.sound: A trending sound with a beat you can cut the jumps to.

tiktok.hook: "POV: you booked the farm stay instead of the hotel."
tiktok.shots: Morning light, coffee, animals outside the window, chores.
tiktok.caption: Wake up here instead. #farmstay #agritourism

facebook.text:
Sourdough day.

The starter is older than some of our animals. It gets fed, it gets folded, it gets baked, and then it goes out the door the same day — full loaves, jalapeño cheddar, bagels, and the gluten-free cookies that people drive out here for.

If you want a loaf, order ahead. We bake to what is ordered, and it goes quickly.

moontreefarm.com/market
facebook.why: Baking season starts now, and pre-orders are how the bakery avoids waste.

tiktok.hook: The crack. Cut into a hot loaf, sound on.
tiktok.shots: Loaf out of the oven. The knife. The crust cracking. The inside, steaming.
tiktok.caption: Baked this morning. #sourdough #breadtok #asmr

tiktok.hook: "How much jalapeño is too much jalapeño?" Keep adding.
tiktok.shots: Folding the dough, adding cheese and jalapeño, more than anyone expects, then the finished loaf cut open.
tiktok.caption: The answer is more. #jalapenocheddar #sourdoughstarter

tiktok.hook: "Our starter is older than this goat." Cut to the goat.
tiktok.shots: Starter jar, bubbling, close. Then a goat looking at the camera. Then the bake.
tiktok.caption: Both are thriving. #sourdoughstarter #farmhumor

facebook.text:
A gift that is not from a warehouse.

The gift baskets are back for the season — soap, lotion, something from the bakery, packed here on the farm. So are the gift cards, which is the right answer when you know somebody likes what we make but you do not know which scent.

Order early enough and we will have it ready for pickup or send it out. Nothing about this is mass produced, so there is a limit to how many we can do in a week.

moontreefarm.com/market
facebook.why: Late October is when holiday gift shopping starts, and the baskets have a real capacity limit worth saying out loud.

tiktok.hook: "Packing a gift basket, start to finish." Then do it in silence.
tiktok.shots: Empty basket. Each item going in, one at a time, hands only. Tie the ribbon. Push it toward the camera.
tiktok.caption: Made here, packed here. #giftbasket #handmadegifts #shopsmall
tiktok.sound: The paper and the ribbon. Maybe something soft underneath.

tiktok.hook: "Gifts from a farm hit different." Show the difference.
tiktok.shots: Split it: a shipping box of something generic, then the same beat but a soap bar coming out of the cure rack.
tiktok.caption: One of these was made by someone who knows your name. #shoplocal #smallbusiness
tiktok.sound: Trending sound with a clear beat drop for the cut.

tiktok.hook: "What do you get the person who has everything?" Hold up a gift card.
tiktok.shots: The card in hand, the QR code close, then someone scanning it and the balance appearing.
tiktok.caption: Scan it, spend it, done. #giftcard #shopsmall
